lamp_check.scope: Native parked Mini lamp actuation, blink cycle, cancellation, synchronized cameras. No learned policy.
lamp_check.analysis: Rear bumper lamp ROIs selected after visual inspection; mean RGB > 56 in the fixed preflight camera. Left/right previews also visually show the corresponding front lamps.

stalk_check.claim: Diagnostic joint commands; no trained indicator policy.
stalk_check.coupling: Engineered point-grip constraint; removal is tested.
stalk_check.mechanism: Counterbalanced spring-centred passive hinge; three measured zones; no latch.

limits: No learned indicator policy has been trained.
Stalk is isolated from the steering wheel.
Lamp and stalk tests are separate runs, not a combined learned-control episode.
Sponsor surfaces are not integrated into the native CARLA vehicle.
CARLA crashed once during scouting camera changes; container restarted. The isolated stalk run completed after retry.
